verdict.rationale: Airweave is a data-sync/search/RAG layer that syncs source data into collections and indexes it for retrieval; the evidence describes syncing, search strategies, webhooks, and connectors but never discusses any memory layer that updates, supersedes, or merges conflicting stored memories based on new contradictory information. There is no mention of memory consolidation, conflict resolution, or contradiction handling anywhere in the docs or community evidence.
